# Sources & Citations

Master citation list for all statistics, claims, and research referenced in the linkedin-review skill. When a user asks "where did that number come from?", direct them to this file.

---

## LinkedIn Platform & Algorithm

### 360Brew Foundation Model
- **Claim:** LinkedIn deployed a 150B-parameter foundation model (360Brew) across 30+ predictive tasks.
- **Source:** LinkedIn Engineering Blog — "360Brew: LinkedIn's 150 Billion Parameter Recommendation Model" (2024)
- **URL:** https://engineering.linkedin.com/blog/2024/360brew--linkedin-s-foundation-model-for-recommendations

### JUDE (Job Understanding and Discovery Engine)
- **Claim:** LinkedIn built an LLM-based job recommendation system replacing legacy term-frequency matching.
- **Source:** LinkedIn Engineering Blog, 2024 — various posts on LLM-based job search
- **URL:** https://engineering.linkedin.com

### InMail Economics
- **Claim:** Recruiters must hold ≥13% reply rate over 14 days or risk credit refunds; per-credit cost ~$10.
- **Source:** LinkedIn Talent Solutions documentation (Recruiter seat terms); widely reported in LinkedIn Talent Blog
- **URL:** https://business.linkedin.com/talent-solutions/recruiter

### Open to Work InMail Lift
- **Claim:** Candidates with recruiter-only Open to Work signal get 14.5% positive InMail responses vs 4.6% without — ~3× lift.
- **Source:** LinkedIn Talent Blog, LinkedIn's own published data on Open to Work signal effectiveness
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/business/talent/blog

### Profile Photo Impact
- **Claim:** Profiles with photos get ~21× more views and ~9× more connection requests.
- **Source:** LinkedIn first-party data, cited in multiple LinkedIn Talent Solutions blog posts
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/business/talent/blog

### Headline Character Limits
- **Claim:** Headline total cap is 220 characters; mobile feed/search cards render the first ~60–70 characters.
- **Source:** LinkedIn Help Center; character counts verified by practitioners via UI testing
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a549097

### Skills Cap Increase
- **Claim:** LinkedIn doubled the Skills cap from 50 to 100 in early 2024.
- **Source:** LinkedIn Help Center — "Adding skills to your LinkedIn profile" (updated 2024)
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a549748

### Skill Assessments Discontinued
- **Claim:** LinkedIn Skill Assessments were discontinued and badges purged in 2024.
- **Source:** LinkedIn Help Center announcement; widely covered by career media
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin

### Verified Skills (Replacement)
- **Claim:** Verified Skills via Microsoft Entra or work email replaced Skill Assessment badges.
- **Source:** LinkedIn product announcements (2024); Microsoft Entra Verified ID documentation
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/verified-id/

### Verified Workplace Profile Views
- **Claim:** Verified members see ~60% more profile views.
- **Source:** LinkedIn's own product announcements on workplace verification
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin

### India-Only Fields (Notice Period & Expected CTC)
- **Claim:** LinkedIn launched Notice Period / Availability and Expected Annual Salary fields exclusively for India users in October 2025, visible only to recruiters.
- **Source:** LinkedIn India blog / product announcement, October 2025
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/blog

### About Section Preview Lengths
- **Claim:** About preview before "See more": ~300 chars desktop, ~200 chars mobile.
- **Source:** Practitioner measurement / UI testing by LinkedIn educators (e.g., Donna Serdula, Andy Foote, Richard van der Blom)
- **URL:** Various LinkedIn creator communities; verified by manual testing

### AI Content Down-Ranking
- **Claim:** AI-detected posts get ~30% less reach and ~55% less engagement.
- **Source:** Richard van der Blom — 2024/2025 LinkedIn Algorithm Report
- **URL:** https://www.richardvanderblom.com

### Engagement Pod Shadow-Bans
- **Claim:** LinkedIn's 2025 enforcement push produced documented shadow-bans (60–90 day reach collapse).
- **Source:** Richard van der Blom 2025 Algorithm Report; practitioner community reports
- **URL:** https://www.richardvanderblom.com

## SSI (Social Selling Index)

### SSI Overview
- **Claim:** SSI is a 0–100 score across 4 pillars of 25 points each, computed daily over a trailing 90-day window, visible only to the profile owner.
- **Source:** LinkedIn Sales Solutions — SSI feature page
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/sales/ssi

### SSI Tier Heuristics
- **Claim:** Average user ~40–50; active ~60–70; top 25% ~65+; top 10% ~75–80+.
- **Source:** Common heuristics from LinkedIn Sales Navigator training materials and third-party sales-tooling vendors (Navigator, Salesforce LinkedIn integration docs). LinkedIn does not publish official tier benchmarks.
- **URL:** https://business.linkedin.com/sales-solutions/sales-navigator

### Realistic 30-Day SSI Lift
- **Claim:** Realistic 30-day lift from inactive baseline: 15–25 points. Reaching 70+ takes 30–45 days.
- **Source:** Practitioner consensus from LinkedIn educators and sales coaches; no official LinkedIn data.
- **URL:** N/A (practitioner consensus)

## Content & Algorithm Research

### Buffer 4.8M-Post Study
- **Claim:** 2–5 posts/week is the sweet spot — daily posting shows diminishing returns.
- **Source:** Buffer — "We Analyzed 4.8 Million LinkedIn Posts. Here's What We Found" (2023/2024)
- **URL:** https://buffer.com/resources/linkedin-posts-study

### Poll Reach Multiplier
- **Claim:** LinkedIn polls get ~1.64× reach multiplier.
- **Source:** Richard van der Blom — LinkedIn Algorithm Report 2025
- **URL:** https://www.richardvanderblom.com

### External Links Reach Reduction
- **Claim:** Practitioner data shows ~25–50% reach reduction for posts with external links in the body. LinkedIn's Sr. Director stated in Aug 2025 that there's no intentional penalty.
- **Source:** Richard van der Blom Algorithm Report 2024/2025; LinkedIn Sr. Director statement via LinkedIn post (August 2025)
- **URL:** https://www.richardvanderblom.com; LinkedIn post by LinkedIn Sr. Director Pete Davies (Aug 2025)

### Comment Thread Depth
- **Claim:** Comment threads with 3+ participants drive the most reach lift.
- **Source:** Richard van der Blom — LinkedIn Algorithm Reports 2024 and 2025
- **URL:** https://www.richardvanderblom.com

### Hashtag Weight Reduction
- **Claim:** LinkedIn drastically reduced hashtag weight; Creator Mode and "Talks About" were retired early 2025.
- **Source:** LinkedIn product announcements (early 2025); Richard van der Blom 2025 Algorithm Report
- **URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin; https://www.richardvanderblom.com

### Carousel Reach
- **Claim:** Well-formatted carousels (PDF slides) still outperform plain text for reach.
- **Source:** Richard van der Blom — LinkedIn Algorithm Report 2025
- **URL:** https://www.richardvanderblom.com

## Market-Specific Sources

### Anti-Discrimination Laws (Photo, UK/US/EU)
- **Claim:** US, UK, Canada, EU, and Australian employers are subject to anti-discrimination laws that make recruiters cautious about applications with photos.
- **Source:** EEOC (US) — Title VII; UK Equality Act 2010; EU GDPR + Employment Equality Directives; Fair Work Act (Australia)
- **URL:** https://www.eeoc.gov; https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/15

### Naukri Freshness Signal
- **Claim:** Updating the Naukri profile every 48 hours moves the candidate up in freshness-sorted recruiter searches.
- **Source:** Naukri recruiter documentation and widely shared practitioner advice; Naukri's own transparency about its freshness-ranking mechanism
- **URL:** https://www.naukri.com/recruiter

## Disclaimer

Statistics about LinkedIn's algorithm, SSI, InMail response rates, and content reach are:
1. Based on published LinkedIn data where available
2. Based on independent practitioner research (Richard van der Blom) where LinkedIn data is unavailable
3. Subject to change as LinkedIn updates its algorithm and platform

LinkedIn does not publish a comprehensive technical spec of its ranking algorithm. All estimates of reach, SSI, and ranking behavior are probabilistic and based on observed patterns, not guaranteed outcomes.

When presenting statistics to a user: attribute the source (LinkedIn, Van der Blom, Buffer, etc.) and qualify with "based on observed patterns" if the stat is from practitioner research rather than LinkedIn's own data.
